'''Danabar''' is a location in [[Andor]] where [[Elayne Trakand]] possesses some estates. It is located in mountainous countryside in the vicinity of the [[Lugard Road]], although not within easy reach of it. In early [[1000 NE]], significant deposits of [[alum]] were found at Danabar, and Elayne used these to fund her claim to the [[Lion Throne]].
